scope: Read-only mathematical analysis of historical source73 actual failed R2 optimizer; no calculated Hessian, new engine call, repaired result or stationarity acceptance

method.gradient_extraction: Last CARTESIAN GRADIENT table in each same numbered cycle (after D4), paired with CARTESIAN COORDINATES (ANGSTROEM) in that exact cycle
method.projection: Ordinary Euclidean Cartesian gradient, not mass-weighted and not Eckart; SVD orthogonal projector from three uniform translations and three e_axis cross (r - arithmetic centroid) rotations; rank6 for whole dimer and rank6 for each nonlinear water monomer
method.global_rotation: Whole rigid projection minus orthogonal uniform-translation projection
method.relative_rigid_monomer_motion: Difference between independent-monomer rigid-body projector and whole-dimer rigid-body projector
method.precision_limits: Coordinates and trajectory printed to six decimal Angstrom digits; gradient components printed to nine decimal Eh/bohr digits; all projections are approximate mathematical diagnostics of printed data
method.interpretation_limit: Native redundant internal gradient and RFO step criteria have their own coordinate scaling; they are not equated to this Euclidean Cartesian projection. Augmented Hessian eigenvalues are optimizer-model quantities, not mass-weighted vibrational frequencies or a physical force-constant Hessian.
method.torque_sign: Gradient torque is sum (r - centroid) cross g; physical force torque is its negative because force=-gradient. The native printed invariance-difference tuple is retained separately.

trajectory.limitation: Six-decimal trajectory quantization is larger than the printed late native Cartesian-conversion RMS; frame differences cannot establish exact Cartesian step convergence or precise molecular drift.

summary.interpretation: The remaining raw Cartesian force is predominantly internal to the dimer, principally relative rigid motion of monomers, not whole-system translation/rotation. Late RFO steps are tiny relative to unchanged trust radius and are not trust-clipped. No physical Hessian eigenvectors are retained here, so no optimizer-model eigenvalue is assigned to a vibrational mode or certified as the cause of the plateau.
